arguments.text: 8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Goal: finish with pod reserve near empty at the line. After the hard start, settle to about sustainable shaft power (pod ~195-200 W). Push a little more on legs against the current/wind, a little less with it. Final sprint from ~400 m to go. Watch for incidents: weed on rudder (speed drops with same pod power, push_local falls), pod drift, radio course changes, wind shifts. Do not over-cue; use watches.

arguments.name: drag_resid
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current along heading; drops if drag rises (weed) or pod reads high

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts for 40 s: weed on rudder, drag, or pod drift?
pod reserve below 20 pct with more than 1200 m left

arguments.text: 1.0 min: watches set: drag_jump (drag_resid=push_local-push_along < -0.3 for 40 s: weed/drag/pod drift), pod_reserve_low (<20 pct with >1200 m left), too_hot (shaft >112 pct of sustainable 60 s), too_easy (<90 pct 60 s). Wake at 700 m left for the sprint. Start: shaft 240 W vs CP 192, leg 1 heading north with +0.27 current push.

text: no cue: hard start is expected to settle on its own; plan, watches and sprint wake-up set.

arguments.reason: just after turn 1: leg 2 is against the current (~0.33 m/s); consider a small push cue, target ground pace ~174

arguments.text: 4 min: settled at shaft 194 W (sustainable 198), pod reserve 73 pct steady. Boat-model reserve falls faster (57 pct) than pod: boat power 134 vs CP 122 while shaft is at CP; trust the pod for effort. Current helps leg 1 (north) ~0.33 m/s.

text: no cue: paddler settled at critical power with reserve to spare; wake after the turn to consider pushing into the current.

arguments.text: Into the current now, lift a touch, hold 2:51 pace

text: cued a small push with 2:51 target pace on the upstream leg 2: more power where the boat is slow is faster for the same effort; check in 2 min.

arguments.reason: after turn 2: downstream leg 3, ease slightly to ~185-190 W shaft to bank reserve

arguments.text: 7 min: push cue on upstream leg 2 worked: shaft 194->206 W, GPS pace 2:47. Pod reserve 65 pct. Boat/shaft power ratio in race ~0.67-0.69 vs 0.635 in the test since min 2, so boat-model reserve (38 pct) drains faster than pod; consistent from the start, so not a mid-race pod drift. Trust pod for effort. Current ~0.25-0.3 m/s, helps going north (odd legs).

text: no cue: push into the current is landing at the intended ~206 W; wake after the turn to ease downstream.
no cue: 49 m to the turn, push faded to critical power naturally; pending wake after the turn handles the downstream leg.

arguments.text: Current with you now, ease a touch, settle at 2:28

text: cued a small ease with 2:28 target on downstream leg 3 (paddler 6/10, feels fine; pod reserve 57 pct): spend less where the current carries the boat.

arguments.message: shaft power under 85 pct of sustainable for a minute

arguments.reason: after turn 3: upstream leg 4, push cue ~205-210 W shaft (target ground pace ~2:50)

arguments.text: 12.2 min: ease cue on downstream leg 3 took shaft 194->174 W (a bit more than asked), GPS pace 2:27 on target; pod reserve rising 57->60 pct. Water speed only ~1.5 pct lower; push_local and fitted push both fell ~0.08, so the current looks slightly weaker (~0.25-0.3) and the pod looks honest, not drifting. Paddler 6/10 at 10.5 min, feels fine. too_easy watch loosened to 85 pct so downstream easing does not wake me.

text: no cue: easing to 174 W downstream is within a sensible range and the reserve is refilling; push again after the next turn.
no cue: shaft 179 W downstream, on target pace, reserve refilling; already handled in note at 12.2 min.
no cue: paddler reports feeling good and steady, numbers agree; nothing to change before the next turn.

arguments.text: Something on the rudder: one back-stroke to clear it

arguments.reason: check whether clear_rudder fixed the drag: shaft power at the same speed should drop back toward ~195 W

arguments.text: 14.7 min: shaft power ramped 176->234 W over 2.5 min (from ~12.5 min) while GPS speed held ~3.4 and water speed flat; push_local fell 0.31->0.02. Paddler: 5/10, boat feels heavy, like something dragging. Suspect weed on rudder (or added drag); cued clear_rudder at 14.8 min, near turn 3. If speed per watt does not recover after the clear, consider water in hull / other drag, or pod reading high. Pod reserve fell to 39 pct during this.

text: cued clear_rudder: power rose 30 pct with no speed gain and the paddler feels something dragging, so likely weed on the rudder; check result in 75 s.

arguments.reason: cue gate opens: shaft 247 W upstream after clear_rudder; decide hold 2:50 (sane target replacing old 2:28) vs pod-drift; check speed per watt

text: no cue: cue gate closed for 16 s and post-turn numbers are still mixed with the back-stroke dip; wake when the gate opens.

arguments.reason: From min 2 to 12 the boat model read boat power ~0.68 of pod shaft power vs 0.635 in the test, so at the pod critical power (192 W) the boat model reads ~130 W, not 122. Rescaling so the boat-model reserve matches the paddler (who reports 5-6/10, fine), because the pod now looks unreliable.

arguments.text: 15.8 min: POD SUSPECT. Pod shaft ramped 176->256 W since 12.8 min with no speed gain (water 3.07, GPS 2:54 upstream vs 2:48 at 200 W on leg 2), yet paddler says 5/10, steady, feels fine (was 6/10 at 195 W). Smooth ramp = drift, not a weed step. clear_rudder at 14.8 was done (dip seen). Ignore pod numbers (shaft power, w_bal_pod, push_local, sustainable_shaft); use boat model + GPS. Removed pod watches; set boat CP 122->130 W (race boat/pod ratio). Leg 2 reference: 2:48 GPS upstream, 3.24 m/s water at true ~200 W.

8000 m, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back; current ~0.25 m/s helps north (odd legs), hurts south (even legs). POD DRIFTING HIGH since ~12.8 min (reads 260 W at true ~200 W): ignore shaft power, w_bal_pod, push_local, sustainable_shaft. Pace on the boat model (CP set to 130 W) and GPS: aim boat power ~140-145 W upstream (GPS ~2:44), ~125-130 W downstream (GPS ~2:27), finish with boat reserve near empty. Final sprint from ~400-500 m to go. Boat watches: boat_hot, boat_easy, boat_reserve_low, fade_drag (weed). Weed cleared by back-stroke at 14.8 min.

text: cued push with 2:44 target upstream: water speed back to 3.2 m/s at boat CP after the clear, boat reserve 66 pct, so there is room to spend into the current; pod confirmed drifting.
